cd /workspace/services/ingestion && cat > test_kh_queue.ts << 'EOF'
import { runKulturhusetSource } from './src/sources/sourceRunner';
async function test() {
  console.log('Testing Kulturhuset queue integration...');
  try {
    const result = await runKulturhusetSource();
    console.log('\n✅ Result:', JSON.stringify(result, null, 2));
    return result;
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('❌ Error:', error.message);
    throw error;
  }
}
test().catch(console.error);
EOF
